"""Fast, correct revenue summary by customer segment and product category."""
import time
import pandas as pd


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    orders = pd.read_csv('/app/orders.csv')
    customers = pd.read_csv('/app/customers.csv')
    products = pd.read_csv('/app/products.csv')

    # Only completed orders count as revenue
    orders = orders[orders['status'] == 'completed']

    # Exclude test customers
    customers = customers[customers['segment'] != 'test']

    df = (orders
          .merge(customers[['customer_id', 'segment']], on='customer_id')
          .merge(products[['product_id', 'category']], on='product_id'))

    # Revenue uses the actual unit_price on the order, not list_price
    df['line_total'] = df['quantity'] * df['unit_price']

    summary = (df.groupby(['segment', 'category'])
                 .agg(total_revenue=('line_total', 'sum'),
                      order_count=('line_total', 'size'))
                 .reset_index()
                 .sort_values(['segment', 'category']))

    summary['total_revenue'] = summary['total_revenue'].round(2)
    summary['avg_order_value'] = (summary['total_revenue'] / summary['order_count']).round(2)

    summary.to_csv('/app/output.csv', index=False)
    print(f"Done in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s, {len(summary)} rows")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
EOF
